fusions.name: Hide Gone Sharp
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Spines burst out of your hide, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Still, Then Strike
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. A spike shot from stillness deals 22 damage to an enemy up to 6 tiles away, rising to 1.3 times as much at full reach.

fusions.name: Shed Skin
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you and restores 12 health.

fusions.name: Afternoon Basking
fusions.desc: In daylight, your armour rises by 12%.
